phases.text: Alice is already signed in. Open the shared Demo Planning channel.
Send a message. Confirmed means it is saved, not that somebody read it.
Bob replies from an independent browser session.
Only Alice goes offline. The real server and Bob stay connected.
Bob sends two messages while Alice is offline. Her draft remains unsent.
Reconnect Alice. Persisted messages arrive through bounded recovery.
Send the retained draft. Recovery does not provide durable offline sending.
